resources.string: Sona is a phone for your Asterisk, or any SIP server: add the extension you were given and call any other.
Your extension and its password are all it needs
Everything stays on this phone: no account with us, no cloud
When something fails, Sona says why, and shows the SIP behind it
What Android must allow for calls to ring and be heard
permissions microphone notifications battery lock screen ring silent not ringing checklist
Everything is ready: calls will ring and be heard.

resources.string: Your server does not wake the phone for a call, so Sona stays registered while it is closed, with a quiet notification that says so. You can turn that off in Settings, under Calls: calls then ring only while Sona is open.
